name: Tab Smash
description: Declutter your browser and your mind. Clean up your tabs without clearing them.

tab-smash.description: Collapse all normal Chrome windows into one

group-smash.description: Collapse all normal Chrome windows into one and group tabs by original window

domain-smash.description: Collapse all normal Chrome windows into one and group tabs by domain

clear-mind.description: Group stale tabs in the current window

smash-and-clear.description: Collapse all normal Chrome windows into one, then group stale tabs
